Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a mouse embryonic fibroblast cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on NIH-3T3 cells, a spontaneously immortalized fibroblast line established from NIH Swiss mouse embryo tissue using the 3T3 serial-transfer protocol and used for fibroblast, stromal, growth, and transformation studies.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from adherent mouse fibroblast cultures: nuclei from the pooled population are recovered, accessible chromatin is fragmented and adapter-tagged by Tn5 transposase, and libraries represent population-level fibroblast accessibility.
